features.label: May not have existed
features.detail: The record is thin enough that scholars genuinely debate whether he is one person, several, or none.

features.label: Action through non-action
features.detail: Wu wei is not passivity. It is the hardest idea in the book to read correctly and the most often mangled.

features.label: Shorter than you expect
features.detail: The whole Tao Te Ching runs about 5,000 characters. The brevity is itself the argument.
